purpose_context: OpenClaw agent skills edited in the repo currently have no path to the deployed skills on office2, so a SKILL.md edit is stranded and can go months out of date with no signal. This mission builds the auto-deploy sync plus a drift check, mirroring the proven agent-prompt-sync mechanism, so deployed skills stay faithful to the repo and any divergence is surfaced.
purpose_tldr: Repo skill edits reach office2, and skill drift is detected instead of accruing silently.
